events.subtitle: New Year Live 2027
events.factual_description: Blue Note Place presents RINA Trio's New Year Live 2027 on Thursday, January 7, 2027. Doors open at 18:00 and the live performance begins at 19:00, with no audience turnover; the venue describes an approximately 60-minute performance and an approximately 30-minute intermission. The announced trio is RINA on piano, Yosuke Inoue on bass and Hiro Kimura on drums. RINA's official discography identifies the same personnel as the trio on her 2025 album JOKER, whose nine tracks are all her compositions. Blue Note Place lists ¥5,000 first-floor and ¥4,000 second-floor charges, plus at least one order per guest.

en.why_it_matters: This is the working trio heard on RINA's all-original JOKER: her crisp, composition-first piano language meets Yosuke Inoue's veteran bass authority and Hiro Kimura's flexible pulse. The value of the date is the chance to hear that recorded ensemble negotiate RINA's contemporary writing in a compact club room, not the seasonal label attached to the night.
en.trip_verdict: If January 7 is free during a Tokyo stay, this is a worthwhile Ebisu club choice for a polished current Japanese piano trio. It does not justify rearranging the trip around the date.

es.why_it_matters: Es el trío de trabajo que se escucha en JOKER, el álbum de composiciones propias de RINA: su lenguaje pianístico nítido y centrado en la escritura se encuentra con la autoridad veterana del bajo de Yosuke Inoue y el pulso flexible de Hiro Kimura. El valor de la fecha está en oír a ese ensamble grabado negociar la escritura contemporánea de RINA en una sala compacta, no en la etiqueta de Año Nuevo.
es.trip_verdict: Si el 7 de enero está libre durante una estancia en Tokio, es una buena elección de club en Ebisu para escuchar un trío japonés actual y muy pulido. No justifica reorganizar el viaje alrededor de la fecha.
